base_image: python:3.11-slim (release pins requires-python>=3.11 but no OS or base image)
environment_contract_findings: py7zr>=0.21 is a declared dependency in pyproject.toml, so the documented `pip install -e .` installs it. The portable-environment ModuleNotFoundError we recorded was an artefact of our fixed dependency set, not a property of the release: this corrects our own first-pass failure attribution.

In the official environment the grading CLI loads and dispatches correctly; it stops at `ValueError: Dataset for competition ... is not prepared`, i.e. the real blocker is Kaggle-gated competition data, not a software defect.
requires-python is pinned but no OS or base image is specified, so the environment is reproducible only up to the auditor's base choice.
